# ui::Size

Header: `winui/core/Geometry.hpp`.

A width/height pair in DIPs: what [Element::measure()](../tree/element.md#measure) returns and takes as `available`.

In a measure offer, [ui::Unbounded](namespace-ui.md#unbounded) (+infinity) on an axis means unbounded; 0 is no room.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::ButtonControl button{"Save"};
const ui::Size    desired = button.measure(ui::Size{300, ui::Unbounded}, measurer, theme);
REQUIRE_FALSE(desired.empty());
```

## width

```cpp
float width = 0.0f
```

Horizontal extent, DIPs.

## height

```cpp
float height = 0.0f
```

Vertical extent, DIPs.

## empty

```cpp
bool empty() const
```

True if either extent is zero or negative, i.e. the size covers no area.
